words.name: WAIT-TITLE

words.name: INIT-TITLE-DISPLAY

words.name: COPY-TEXT-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies 40 bytes from the temporary line buffer into the requested screen row.

words.name: CLEAR-TEXT-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Erases 40 bytes at the requested screen row.

words.name: RENDER-CENTERED-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Temporarily switches the OS screen pointer to a 40-byte buffer, renders centered text, then restores it.

words.name: SCROLL-EIGHT-PIXELS
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes 0,2,4,6 into ANTIC VSCROL ($D405), pausing one tick between values.

words.name: SCROLL-TITLE-ROW
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Moves the prepared row through screen lines with vertical fine scrolling, polling for the skip trigger.

words.name: SCROLL-TITLE-TEXT
words.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up consecutive packed lines, centers them in the temporary buffer and scrolls each into the title area.

words.name: SHOW-TITLE-PAGE

words.name: SHOW-TITLE-SEQUENCE
